analyst.summary: Pricol delivered strong headline growth this year (profit roughly doubled) in its instrument-cluster and auto-components business, benefiting from the broader 2-wheeler and commercial-vehicle cycle. However, its return on equity (3.5%) is unusually low compared to its return on capital employed (19.5%) - a gap that is not fully explained by the information available and is worth clarifying before assuming the reported growth translates cleanly into shareholder value. At over 30 times earnings, the valuation already assumes strong, clean execution.
